value.title: Phase 2: rename, code paths, coverage sensor (coder)
value.summary: Roadmaps move to workstreams (folder and schema), the coverage sensor joins harness checks, and the governance roles are re-pointed after the merge. Delivered by #160 and #161.

value.title: The rename: roadmaps to workstreams
value.success: docs/project/roadmaps and the skill's examples/roadmaps move to workstreams/ with git mv and switch to pij/workstream in the same commit (ddocs E406), with changelog rows; every live reference follows; s16 is added and complete. Readers (claims, delivered, the directory needs fold) already scan both folders.

value.title: The coverage sensor
value.success: harness/scripts/coverage-check.ts runs as just coverage-check, a coverage stage in harness checks and a step in just self-check. It names every undelivered requirement, unbuilt component and complete umbrella with an unfinished child; inputs fail closed; APPROVED_EXEMPTIONS and coverage-exemptions.json are the same set of existing, uncovered rows; repeated sections and row ids fail.

value.title: Governance re-point
value.success: After #160 merged, ac7-repoint.sh re-pointed the 8 live roles to docs/project/workstreams/ with pij directory edit, one writer commit each; the live wording followed (coder and pm-001 say workstream).

value.title: Cost
value.success: The sensor reads three folders of JSON once per harness checks run. No loop, poll, timer, hook or launch site, and no daemon change.

value.title: Docs, states and verdicts
value.success: s16 complete; req-30 and req-31 shipped with delivered_by #160; the PR body carries a Delivers line; the plan's states and evidence are true.

tk-0006.assertion: ddocs-check and ddocs validate pass on docs/project; no live docs/project/roadmaps path remains outside history, shipped template bytes and the claim alias; claims_http, directory_http and community:: tests pass.

tk-0007.assertion: coverage-check passes on the head, and its vitest cases (missing coverage, the umbrella, every exemption rule, fail-closed reads, duplicates) pass in CI; each guard was mutation-checked.

tk-0008.assertion: No live field in the 8 roles' role.dd.json and no ROUTES.md row cites docs/project/roadmaps/ or says roadmap; the writer commits are listed in the evidence.

tk-0009.assertion: Performance's verdict on #160 at 4a0bc62 (ocelot ecbbf94) finds no new recurring daemon cost.

tk-0010.assertion: just ddocs-check passes; CI green and pr-freeze FINAL on #160's head; reviewer, security and performance verdicts pass-with-notes at 4a0bc62.
